name: Private Residence 4
desc: A collection of expressive bedrooms shaped by tactile surfaces, deep colour, sculptural lighting and finely detailed contemporary joinery.
desc2: Private Residence 4 explores three distinct bedroom identities within a cohesive contemporary language. Rich timber, smoked glass and layered wall treatments create depth, while deep green, cocoa and muted rose accents give each room an individual mood. Rounded furniture, bespoke storage and warm indirect lighting balance the strong material character with softness and residential comfort.
imageAlt: Contemporary bedroom in Pune with deep green textiles, textured terracotta wall and dark glazed wardrobes
